about: Per-platform masks of PLAN section 2.5 gate 5, keyed by process.platform as run.json records it. Rects are CSS px of the window content; deviceRow and deviceColumn are device pixels, negative from the bottom or right; transparent masks pixels with alpha 0 on either side. Per-capture masks (focused text inputs, webviews, scrollbars, scenario selectors) come from the capture records of both sides.
